Quick take after reviewing v1.3 and Nebula’s ask:
- Send Nebula_Rate_Sheet_v1.3.pdf as the authoritative file. Note the version and date in the email body so procurement knows it’s the current external artifact.
- For the ~200M tokens/month run-rate example: use the Tier 2 unit price in the sheet and show blended price with an example table (I’ll drop the numbers into a quick sheet and share).
- Discount guidance (recommended):
  • 12-month commit: 8–12% off baseline list depending on signal (usage history, referenceability).
  • 24-month commit: 15% off baseline with milestone-based true-ups.
  • Pilot concession: waive onboarding fee + 1 month of credits equivalent to ~10% of their first-month expected usage (applied as bill credits).
- Consumption floor: offer a 3-month pilot with a small minimum (e.g., 30% of committed monthly run-rate) and allow credits to convert into future usage if exceeded.

Operational notes: stamp the PDF filename with v1.3 and upload to the contract drive. Keep a changelog entry (v1.3 — 2026-02-26 — shared with Nebula; K. Iyer). If they ask for tracked redlines, route to legal with the redline request + hubspot deal id.

If you want I can draft the external email: 2 short bullets (what’s attached + run-rate example) + 1 sentence on commercial levers.
